title: SoS: Analysis of Surface-over-Semantics in Multilingual Text-To-Image Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on quantifying cultural stereotypes and language-induced visual bias in text-to-image models using a novel metric (SoS score). While religious artifacts (e.g., temples, mosques) appear in the visual analysis of cultural tropes, the study does not evaluate religious doctrines, moral frameworks, or theology as a primary objective.
